products.name: Harvey AI
products.note: Legal AI assistant; contract drafting; case research; law firm data exposure; privilege concerns

profile_text.body:
Harvey is a San Francisco-based company that develops AI software for legal and professional services. According to its website, its platform is designed for law firms and corporate legal teams and is used to streamline contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, and litigation work. The company describes itself as built to meet the standards of leading professional service firms, and in 2025 it reported new customer wins, product updates, and expanded global operations.

The company's primary product is Harvey AI, a legal AI assistant that covers contract drafting, case research, and related workflows. Harvey also states that it publishes research findings and contributes to the open-source community around its underlying models and methods.

The site's held facts place Harvey's headquarters in San Francisco, California, and associate the company with 161 California law exposure entries, reflecting noted concerns around law firm data exposure and legal privilege issues tied to its product. No litigation cases, MCP servers, or SEC or patent filings are recorded in the current held facts.
